Safe Passive.description: Zero active probes. Purely passive metadata, TLS/SSL handshake, security headers, cookie attributes, server banners, and public robots.txt inspection.

Bug Bounty Standard.description: Standard non-destructive assessment. Passive checks plus carefully controlled, rate-limited validation checks (OPTIONS methods, CORS reflection, HTTPS redirection). No state changes, no credential attacks, no DoS.

Strict Program Compliance.description: Restricted mode honoring narrow program mandates. Only non-destructive header and TLS validation. Ignores active method probes and requires explicit check approval.

Local Lab.description: Permits localhost, 127.0.0.1, and private lab subnets for testing locally hosted vulnerable apps (DVWA, Juice Shop). Runs all non-destructive modules with rate controls.
